methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified against primary brand pages (us.braun.com, usa.philips.com, ulike.com, jovs.com, smoothskin.com, trynood.com, kenzzi.com) and reputable retailer/review sources (Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, LovelySkin, wearebodybeautiful.com, healthybeautiful.com, innerbody.com). Spec conventions unchanged from draft: flash_window_cm2 = primary body treatment window area; intensity_levels = count of user-selectable power/energy steps; lamp_lifespan_flashes = manufacturer-stated total flash count (string when 'unlimited'); skin_tone_sensor = boolean for an automatic ELECTRONIC sensor that READS skin tone before each flash (a mere skin-CONTACT sensor does NOT qualify); power = corded/cordless; modes lists supported flash application methods; body_and_face = boolean (true if approved for facial use below cheekbones). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP/retail confirmed from US sources; null where no published US price could be confirmed. Where a headline spec could not be corroborated from a credible source, it was set to null rather than guessed. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Braun Silk-expert Pro 5 PL5137
products.priceNote: US MSRP/retail (Best Buy, Walmart); street price frequently ~$325-329
products.provenance: Braun US page confirms 10 intensity levels, 400,000 flashes, Smart SkinProtect / SensoAdapt auto skin-tone sensor (reads skin tone 80x/sec), and body+face use ('head to toe'). Three named treatment MODES (normal/sensitive/extra sensitive) are distinct from the 10 intensity levels. Corded confirmed by Walmart listing title ('Corded'). Flash window 3 cm² (1x3 cm head) and 2019 release per wearebodybeautiful.com. $349.99 is the standard US MSRP listed at Best Buy/Walmart; verified actively sold in the US.

products.name: Braun Silk-expert Pro 3 PL3221
products.provenance: wearebodybeautiful.com confirms 3 intensity levels (3-4 J/cm2), 300,000 flashes, advanced auto skin-tone sensor, corded (fixed 2m cord), both glide and stamp modes, and body+face use (precision attachment for face). Flash window 3 cm² (1x3 cm body head). $199.97 Walmart US. Release year not found in any source -> null.

products.name: Philips Lumea Prestige BRI956
products.priceNote: No published US MSRP: device is UK/EU market only and not FDA-cleared in the US; only eBay reseller listings exist, so priceUsd set to null
products.provenance: Original draft source (philips.co.uk/c-p/BRI956_00) now returns HTTP 404; replaced with the wearebodybeautiful comparison page, which loads and confirms 5 energy levels (2.5-6.5 J/cm2), 4.1 cm² body / 2 cm² face windows, 250,000 flashes, skin-tone sensor (Check & match), and both corded and cordless operation. The review explicitly notes the Prestige is 'Not yet FDA-cleared in US' with no US distribution; the draft's $529.99 was an eBay reseller price, not a published US MSRP, so priceUsd is null. Release year not confirmed -> null.

products.name: Philips Lumea IPL 7000 Series BRI931
products.provenance: Philips US page confirms 5 light energy settings, SmartSkin / SenseIQ auto skin-tone sensor, 4.1 cm² body attachment, both slide-and-flash and stamp-and-flash, corded (2m cord), and a SINGLE curved body attachment only (no face attachment) -> body_and_face false. $399 confirmed on Amazon US and corroborated by celliara review. Lamp lifespan in flashes not published by Philips -> null. ~2025 release per Amazon listing.

products.name: Philips Lumea 9000 Series BRI984
products.priceNote: Philips US online store unavailable (no MSRP); only eBay/reseller listings (~$427 open-box) found, so priceUsd set to null
products.provenance: Philips US page confirms 5 light energy settings, SmartSkin sensor, 4.1 cm² body / 2 cm² face attachments, slide-and-flash + stamp-and-flash, corded use, and 4 attachments (body/face/bikini/armpit) -> body_and_face true. Lamp lifespan in flashes not published -> null. No published US price could be confirmed: Philips US online store shows 'online shop currently unavailable'; only eBay open-box (~$426.95) listings exist, so the draft's ~$469 estimate is dropped and priceUsd set to null. Sold in the US per Amazon listing.

products.name: Ulike Sapphire Air3
products.priceNote: Listed regular price ~$300+ on Ulike US; frequently discounted (~$229 with code)
products.provenance: healthybeautiful.com esthetician review confirms 3 power modes (Soft/Body/Power), 3.2 cm² flash window, 1,000,000 flashes, corded, spot (stamp) and auto-glide methods, and body+face (below cheekbones) use. CORRECTION: the Air3 has only a skin-CONTACT sensor (fires when window touches skin), NOT an automatic skin-tone-reading sensor (unlike the Air 10's SmartSkin). Per spec definition, skin_tone_sensor corrected true -> false. Release year not stated -> null.

products.name: Ulike Air 10
products.priceNote: MSRP $399 per Ulike US; typical sale ~$319-349
products.provenance: healthybeautiful.com confirms 10 energy levels (5-26 J), 3.9 cm² spot size, 300,000 flashes, corded (24V/90W adapter), Fast/Normal/High + SHR modes (glide auto + manual stamp), body+face (below cheekbones). The Air 10 DOES have an automatic SmartSkin skin-tone sensor (verified vs Air 3) -> skin_tone_sensor true. $399 MSRP per Ulike US. Release 2024 per PRNewswire launch announcement (added; draft had null).

products.name: Nood The Flasher 2.0
products.priceNote: MSRP $199 on trynood.com; frequently on sale at $149
products.provenance: trynood.com confirms $199 MSRP / $149 sale, corded (detachable power cable), and full body+face use. innerbody.com review confirms 7 intensity levels, a skin-CONTACT sensor only (no skin-tone sensor) -> skin_tone_sensor false, and corded operation. CORRECTION: lamp_lifespan_flashes 500,000 -> null: no primary/credible source confirms the count (draft cited the dubious 'manualslibraryy.com'; third-party figures conflict 500k vs 600k). Flash window cm² not published -> null. ~2022 release per Amazon ASIN/press references.

products.name: JOVS Venus Pro II
products.priceNote: Current sale price on jovs.com; listed MSRP $429
products.provenance: jovs.com confirms product named 'Venus Pro II', $299 sale / $429 MSRP. 12.5 cm² sapphire window, 6 intensity levels (max 6 J/cm2), and unlimited flashes confirmed by review sources. Corded operation. Six interchangeable filter heads (face/arms/armpits/legs/bikini/skin-rejuvenation); stamp and glide supported; body+face confirmed. No automatic skin-tone sensor -> skin_tone_sensor false. Canonical source URL updated to the working jovs.com/products/jovs-venus-pro-2-hair-removal-device. First independent reviews dated Nov 2023 -> release estimate 2023.

products.name: SmoothSkin Pure Fit
products.provenance: smoothskin.com official US page confirms $349, 10 intensity settings, unlimited flashes, patented auto skin-tone sensor, corded (separate power pack), glide & stamp (plus Power/Gentle/Speed comfort modes), and full body+face use. Flash window listed as 1.2 x 0.4 in = ~3 cm² (0.48 sq in x 6.45). Release year not stated -> null.

products.name: Kenzzi IPL Pro+
products.priceNote: Sale price per kenzzi.com Pro+ product page
products.provenance: kenzzi.com confirms $249, 1,000,000 flashes, glide mode, and full-body use. 5 intensity levels and an auto skin-tone sensor (detects safe tone before flashing) confirmed by spec aggregators. Cordless (600mAh rechargeable, ~50 min/charge) confirmed by listing data. CORRECTION: flash window 3 -> 4.2 cm²: the cited 0.65 in² treatment window converts to 4.2 cm² (0.65 x 6.4516), as even the draft's own note acknowledged; 3 cm² was an unsupported downward guess. Release year not found -> null.

products.name: Iluminage Touch
products.priceNote: US price per LovelySkin and beautyora listings ($449)
products.provenance: LovelySkin confirms $449, unlimited pulses (Quartz cartridge), corded (power cord), and body+face use (precision adapter for face/underarm/bikini). 3 intensity speeds (low/medium/high) per reviews. Uses IPL+RF (eLOS), FDA-cleared for all skin tones, so no electronic skin-tone sensor -> skin_tone_sensor false. Stamp-only operation. Flash window ~2.5 cm² (2.5 x 1 cm) per applicator spec. Product confirmed still actively sold in 2026 (LovelySkin, Bloomingdale's). Release year not confirmed -> null.
